SourceProxy.name: SetValuePlugin
SourceProxy.label: Set Value Plugin
SourceProxy.Documentation: This filter sets values in a specified array.

StringVectorProperty.name: DataType
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Select the type of data to modify: 'Point Data' or 'Cell Data'.

IntVectorProperty.name: IsVector
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Specify if the quantity is a vector (True) or a scalar (False).

StringVectorProperty.name: ArrayName
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Specify the name of the array to modify.

IntVectorProperty.name: Component
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Specify the component index of the array to modify. Only applicable if the quantity is a vector.
